narrative.overview: NEIMAN OS is built for operators who value information density, precision, and architectural calm over decorative spectacle. It blends the crisp, typographic restraint of modern developer instruments (Linear, Vercel, Cursor) with the real-time observability of an aerospace telemetry center. Every pixel is purposeful, legible, and directly tied to live underlying state.
keyCharacteristics: Calm, High-Contrast Precision: 4.5:1+ WCAG contrast ratios across all states, light and dark.
Tonal Hierarchy: Depth is conveyed via subtle 1px hairlines and structured background surfaces rather than loud drop shadows.
High-Scanability Telemetry: Tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums), monospaced timestamps, and state beacons communicate system health in milliseconds.
Keyboard-First Ergonomics: Universal command palette (Cmd/Ctrl + K), integrated bash terminal toggle (Ctrl + `), visible focus indicators, and accessible interactive landmarks.

rules.name: The Rarity Rule
rules.body: The primary high-contrast fill (bg-primary) is restricted to <= 10% of any given operational viewport. Its scarcity preserves intentional hierarchy.

rules.name: The No-Grey-On-Color Rule
rules.body: On colored or accented surfaces, secondary text is tinted directly from the surface hue or pure foreground, never generic muted grey.

rules.name: The No-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: No kicker or eyebrow labels above headings. The headline carries its own context without decorative scaffolding.

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Rule
rules.body: All metrics, countdowns, confidence percentages, timestamps, and pricing displays must enforce tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums).

dos: Do maintain 100% truth in presentation: all buttons, toggles, heatmaps, and metrics must connect to verified backend routines.
Do enforce tabular numbers (tnum) across all pricing, latency, token, confidence, and countdown displays.
Do provide accessible keyboard shortcuts (Cmd/Ctrl + K, Ctrl + `, Escape) and visible focus indicators.
Do preserve clean high-contrast light mode as the default experience alongside Obsidian monochrome dark mode.
donts: Don't use decorative purple/violet AI gradients or cyan-on-dark neon clichés.
Don't use asymmetrical colored side-tabs or thick border-left (border-l-4) accents on cards.
Don't use kicker or eyebrow text above headings.
Don't present hardcoded mock data or synthetic contribution history as live operational state.
Don't use decorative hairline grid-line backgrounds unless on an actual canvas, map, or blueprint viewport.
